summary: The Backrooms: Level 0 is a multiplayer survival game in a seeded yellow maze: players scavenge and fight smilers and lurkers, manage sanity, and level up while seeking the exit. world.config.yaml wires the player, camera and HUD; shared maze/tuning/loot code supports the main place and a separate combat test room, and the safe-room scene also hosts the modeling-studio mod.
places: places/main (default place, 3D) - Level 0's nine-cell maze and safe hub; x0z0.scene contains the maze mesh, hub props and modeling-studio display, other cells carry the authored lights, and places/main/sim.js replenishes floor pickups and enemies.

places/debug (3D) - isolated test room around x=100 with weapon, almond-water and ammo stations, penned smiler/lurker release pads, level/heal pads, and a return-to-main pad; places/debug/sim.js maintains its test items and releases enemies on request.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer world entry: main default place, player/camera templates, inputs, lighting, arrival handler, HUD and nametags.
templates/player.js - player body/tag and behavior chain; humanoid-locomotion.js intentionally runs before player.js.
templates/camera.js - custom look-oriented camera; scripts/camera.js owns yaw/pitch.
places/main/config.yaml - 3D maze atmosphere, spawn and gravity; terrain is off and scripts/look-default.js is the active look.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - hub and maze scene, including authored almond props and the placed mods/modeling-studio/templates/studio.js#studio display.
places/main/cells/* - remaining eight cells provide the rest of the partitioned Level 0 and authored light placements.
places/debug/config.yaml and places/debug/cells/x1z0.scene - separate no-terrain test-room setup and its stations, pens, labels and trigger pads.
sim.js - world-level cadence/tick entry is empty; active place-level simulation is in places/main/sim.js and places/debug/sim.js.
shared: scripts/lib/maze.js - canonical seeded maze coordinate, zone, hub, wall, arch, pit, pillar, light and exit helpers; shared by level geometry, player, enemy AI and main place spawning.
scripts/lib/data/level0.yml - common maze dimensions and survival, combat, enemy and spawn tuning, read by maze/gameplay/AI/place sims and debug pads.
scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml - ordered weapon keys, stats, rarity/roll and ammo/pickup tuning used by player, UI, loot/spawning, weapon geometry and debug stations.
scripts/lib/loot.js and scripts/lib/debug-layout.js - shared tagged pickup/drop construction and the debug room's fixed test-slot coordinates.
scripts/lib/shapes.js - mesh primitives used by almond, smiler, lurker and weapon geometry.
scripts/lib/data/player.yml and scripts/lib/data/camera.yml - movement/turn and camera defaults consumed by locomotion and camera behavior.
mods/modeling-studio/ - installed creator tool: scene template, player/god-mode behaviors, HUD/panel and display render its world-state-backed models; scripts/ui.js imports its HUD integration.
mods/aaa-quality-kit/ and mods/raytraced-lighting/ - installed creator skill/look resources; look-cinema.js and look-raytrace.js are optional variants, not the active place look.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js and places/debug/sim.js - export cadence, tick.
scripts/lib/maze.js - exports N, S, H, HALF, hash, inHub, zoneOf, cellCenter, cellAt, zoneAt, wallX, wallZ, isArchWall, hasPit, hasPillar, hasLight, EXIT, ZONE_NAMES.
scripts/player.js - exports maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, onInput, update; scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js each export update.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - exports sit, onInput, update; scripts/camera.js - exports finiteNumber, update.
scripts/level0-geo.js - exports geometry; scripts/almond-geo.js, scripts/smiler-geo.js and scripts/lurker-geo.js export geometry/collider; scripts/weapon-geo.js exports geometry/collider.
scripts/lib/loot.js - exports spawnAlmond, spawnWeapon, spawnAmmo, rollWeapon, dropLoot; scripts/lib/debug-layout.js exports ROOM and test slot/pen constants.
scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js - default renderers; scripts/lighting.js exports lighting; scripts/arrival.js exports onArrive/onLeave; scripts/debug-pad.js exports onTriggerEnter.
mods/modeling-studio/templates/studio.js - exports studio; mods/modeling-studio/studio.js exports updateSchedule and update; mods/modeling-studio/player.js exports onInput and onBugMailed.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state owns level/XP, HP, sanity, stamina, battery, almond count, visited-cell/zone tracking, kills/deaths, weapon inventory/equipped weapon and survival/combat timestamps; local control scratch belongs in player.session.
scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - enemy state.hp/dead is the shared combat row; each AI's prey/path/bite scratch is namespaced in enemy session.
places/main/sim.js - main place.state owns seeded flags and next refill times for almonds, weapons, ammo, smilers and lurkers.
places/debug/sim.js - debug place.state owns seeded/refill timing and want_smiler/want_lurker release requests set by debug pads.
scripts/camera.js - camera state owns yaw and pitch; templates/camera.js initializes them.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - body state holds shared turn/seat fields; gait smoothing and measured-pace scratch is in body session.

mods/modeling-studio/ - world.state.m3d owns shared studio model/edit/bug records; player state owns studioOpen/preview/display and bug-inbox UI flags, while player session owns local previews and manipulation scratch.
scripts/ui.js - owns no gameplay state; renders player.state and weapon tuning, with the modeling-studio HUD as an imported extension.
flows: world.config.yaml input axes/actions → templates/player.js → humanoid-locomotion.js turns/animates first, then scripts/player.js moves the body and handles survival, weapon use, pickups and combat.
world.config.yaml camera template → scripts/camera.js reads look orientation and writes camera yaw/pitch; player movement uses aim yaw.
scripts/player.js writes player.state survival/level/weapons → scripts/ui.js and mods/modeling-studio/hud.js read it to render the HUD.
scripts/player.js attack → tagged smiler/lurker state.hp/dead; scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js run AI, reward/remove dead enemies and damage/sap sanity from players.
scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js target ctx.place.players and write prey player.state HP/sanity → scripts/ui.js; damage effects are audience-targeted to the affected player.

places/main/sim.js (1s) queries almond/weapon/ammo/smiler/lurker tags, reads level0.yml/weapons.yml and uses loot.js/maze.js → spawns/refills safe-zone-aware pickups and enemies; its state stores timers.

scripts/player.js reads maze zone/cell/exit helpers for location/survival/exit behavior; enemy AI uses the same seeded layout for paths/targeting; scripts/level0-geo.js uses it to build matching geometry.

places/debug/cells/x1z0.scene trigger pads → scripts/debug-pad.js onTriggerEnter → player stat resets, debug place.state enemy-release requests, or ctx.cross(player, 'main'); places/debug/sim.js consumes the release flags and spawns penned enemies.
places/debug/sim.js (1s) reads scripts/lib/debug-layout.js and weapon tuning → maintains fixed weapon/almond/ammo displays; its almond pickups use the uploaded GLB asset.
world.config.yaml engine.behaviors → scripts/arrival.js onArrive/onLeave; handlers are empty. world.config.yaml ui.render/nametag → scripts/ui.js/ui/nametag.js.
world.config.yaml lighting → scripts/lighting.js; each place's atmosphere.look currently selects scripts/look-default.js (optional mod look scripts are not selected).

modeling-studio player/god behaviors and panel → world.state.m3d model records → placed studio behavior renders the canvas, pedestal and shelf in main hub; scripts/ui.js delegates the player-side HUD to the mod.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* authored lights - many repeated warm fluorescent fixtures across the nine cells, with red-zone variants and locations aligned to the maze layout.

scripts/almond-geo.js, scripts/smiler-geo.js, scripts/lurker-geo.js and scripts/weapon-geo.js - scripted models share scripts/lib/shapes.js tube/sphere helpers; weapon geometry varies by weapons.yml kind, while spawned debug/main almonds use the shared geo or uploaded bottle model as configured.
templates/player.js behavior chain - humanoid-locomotion.js precedes player.js so gait reads prior body movement before player control writes velocity.

scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - parallel enemy update loops share player targeting, maze path/line checks, bite/death/effect patterns, with lurker gaze-freeze/sanity behavior and enemy-specific tuning.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - no active place uses it; both places explicitly have terrain off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/reed.js - no active terrain layers or placed references; main/debug terrain is off.
migrationNotes: scripts/lib/maze.js and scripts/lib/data/level0.yml are a coupled layout contract: keep geometry, zones, spawning and AI rules aligned; maze uses 36 cells at 4 metres each, around HALF, with 3m walls.
The safe hub spans indices 16–19 on both axes; mesh doorway, zone logic and enemy restrictions depend on this shared definition; the exit is maze cell (0,33).
The player template order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js; reversing it changes which velocity locomotion reads.
Player progression/inventory is player.state; per-player control scratch and enemy AI scratch belong in their session namespaces, not shared state.
weapons.yml order/keys are a contract across cycling, pickups, drops, debug slots and weapon-geo params; pistol/ammo fields are used together by ranged combat and ammo pickups.

The debug room is at x≈100, far outside the maze coordinate grid; debug-layout.js owns its station coordinates, and its pads request one enemy release through place.state rather than automatically releasing penned enemies.
